signature_moves: Accent-withheld monochrome: selection is neutral gray inset fill with white (not accent) label in both sidebar and list; the single hue (amber #FB9800) is spent only on folder glyphs, never UI state

AI companion split: split-view toggle opens the source note beside an AI-generated derivative note (differently titled 'kid-simple' rewrite) with its own +/history chrome — 'thinks with you' rendered as a two-editor layout

defects: Contrast Dilution (borders) — 1px column dividers #262626-on-#1E1E1E (~1.1:1), panes separated by tone alone; <3:1
Line Length Fatigue — editor body runs full ~600pt column (~80ch), no ~65ch measure cap
Native selection grammar deviation — selection/focus/primary carry no system accent (deliberate signature; small Jakob's-Law prediction-error cost)
Minor: Settings gear in editor toolbar (macOS convention = Settings window via Cmd-,), not toolbar chrome

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (dark-neutral variant) — but deliberately rotated OFF the default 'dark neutral + one electric accent' reflex: amber-instead-of-electric, and the accent is withheld from UI state entirely

psychology: Von Restorff / Aesthetic-Usability — extreme monochrome restraint lowers perceptual load (fewer working-memory slots spent on chrome) and lets content + the single amber hue register; polish buys first-contact trust

Jakob's Law — honours native conventions (source list, traffic lights, sentence-case headers) so users feel at home, but violates the learned 'selection = accent' expectation, a small prediction-error cost
Miller/Cowan chunking — note list chunked by time (Today / Previous 30 Days), sidebar grouped under Folders; ~3-5 chunks per level
Hick's / progressive disclosure — four panes disclose folder -> note -> editor -> AI derivative left-to-right; formatting tools grouped in one toolbar cluster
notes: Evidence is a single marketing composite (cover.jpg): near-black hero backdrop + display-grotesque headline (brand, NOT app) framing a real app WINDOW cut off at its vertical midpoint — only the top ~40% of the workspace is visible (no empty state, settings, sheets, light mode, or scrolled content). Scale anchored to ~1x via 27px traffic-light pitch matching the macOS-27 kit; all pt values are (estimated) from a JPEG. Lineage native but confidence only medium: density + sentence-case headers + exact system bg argue native/SwiftUI, yet a polished Tauri build could mimic this — do not feed to native canon without a cleaner in-app screenshot. Dark mode prevents confirming/denying Liquid Glass on the toolbar (insufficient-evidence). Icon.png (3D purple grapes, glossy, emoji-adjacent) present but NOT digested — task is Workflow A (UI) only; it contrasts the austere UI with warmth. Brand backdrop shows correct action singularity (one filled white primary + one outlined ghost).
